items.name: b-arcwright-static-field
items.subject: STATIC FIELD, the Arcwright charges the ground: seen from slightly above, the coiled brass tip of the Arcwright's coil lance (upper left) is driven down into dark earth, and a wide flat disc of crackling violet static lightning spreads across the ground from it in a circle, short arcs leaping up out of the ground and snapping around the thin legs of a dark enemy insect caught inside the circle. Energy colour: violet and electric white.

items.name: b-warden-bulwark-pulse
items.subject: BULWARK PULSE, the Warden shields its allies: the Warden's brass field projector in the centre, its round glass dome glowing violet inside a brass cage, releasing one wide expanding ring of translucent steel-blue light that rolls outward over the ground, and three small translucent dome shields of blue-white light forming over dark beetle soldiers around it. Energy colour: cold steel-blue and white around a violet glass core.

items.name: b-juggernaut-broadside
items.subject: BROADSIDE, the Juggernaut fires both cannons at once: close-up of the Juggernaut's two heavy brass-banded royal-blue cannon barrels side by side, pointing diagonally to the upper right, both firing in the same instant with huge orange-white muzzle flashes, a thick billow of dark smoke and two black iron shells streaking away. Energy colour: hot orange and white.

items.name: b-juggernaut-furnace-plating
items.subject: FURNACE PLATING, the Juggernaut's armour shrugs off magic: one massive curved royal-blue riveted armour plate with heavy brass edging, seen head-on, a glowing orange furnace grille in its centre radiating heat; thin violet magic bolts strike its face from both sides and splash apart into harmless fizzling sparks. Energy colour: warm furnace orange, with small violet splashes.

items.name: b-steamwing-flak-beam
items.subject: FLAK BEAM, the Steamwing's beam is tuned against flyers: close-up of the Steamwing's brass nose emitter with its glowing blue-violet glass lens tip (lower left), firing one straight bright blue-violet beam diagonally up to the upper right, where it strikes a dark winged enemy flying insect that bursts in a ring of white flak sparks. Energy colour: blue-violet and white.

items.name: b-tinker-patch-up
items.subject: PATCH UP, the Tinker bolts fresh plates onto a machine: the Tinker's giant brass wrench (from the upper left) turning a big hex bolt that fastens a fresh, bright, new steel plate over a dented gash in a royal-blue riveted machine hull, brass rivets around it, a soft warm golden glow of restoration spreading from the new plate. Energy colour: warm gold with a few orange sparks. No welding torch.

items.name: b-breacher-armor-breaker
items.subject: ARMOR BREAKER, every drill strike cracks the target's armour: extreme close-up of the Breacher's spiral steel drill bit driving into a thick dark-brown enemy armour plate from the lower left; the plate splits open with bright jagged glowing cracks radiating from the point of impact and shards breaking off, orange sparks. No wall, no stone. Energy colour: hot orange and white.
